propositions: Outbound differ compares in vendor-shaped Jira namespace while inbound differ compares in canonical local namespace, creating asymmetry that blocks epic bbf1 AC3.
Current outbound path imports jira-specific helpers that keep vendor payload knowledge in core, violating ADR 0035 §(d) seam principle (backends should not consume vendor-shaped dicts).
Outbound snapshot entry must be canonicalized via injected InboundMapper before field comparison, mirroring inbound differ's canonicalization at inbound_differ.py:159.
OutboundMapper requires new method map_fields_to_remote(local_fields) to emit vendor payload from canonical changed-field subset at emission boundary only.
Jira InboundMapper output must widen with canonical aliases (assignee_identity, remote_parent_id, reporter_identity) that tolerate partial _BASELINE_FIELDS input dicts without defaulting absent keys.
Outbound differ must contain no adapters.jira module import and no raw Jira snapshot key literals (accountId, emailAddress, displayName, etc.), enforced by AST + denylist test gate.
